page.layout: Running head at top centre with page number at top right; below it a heading line with title and roman numeral; then a full-width woodcut illustration of a sun, moon and earth with mountains (no text inside); below it an emblem motto in verse set as running text with a large initial F; at the foot a signature mark on the right.
page.notes: The woodcut shows the sun at top, a moon in the lower centre, and a ring of earth in the middle, with mountains at the sides; no printed words within it. The large initial F is a decorative woodcut letter, transcribed as F. Long s rendered as plain s. The verse line "Pleno corufcat lumine_:" has a printed mark at its end, kept as printed.
